drift20.text:
Peter picked a bunch of purple plums by the big brown barn.
My mom made pumpkin bread, but Bob baked the best pie.
Please bring me the map before the boat leaves the harbor.
The weather today is mild, with a light breeze from the west.
Maybe we can meet by the bridge at about half past nine.
